heading.en: From one bit to a whole number

hook.en: A full *adder* adds one column. Line up four of them and the carry passes from column to column, just like when you add on paper. The same adder can even subtract.

title.en: Design the half and full subtractor

say.en: A full adder adds one column. Line up four of them and the carry passes from column to column, just like when you add on paper. The same adder can even subtract. In this lesson: Explain a 4-bit parallel (ripple-carry) adder.
Design the half and full subtractor.
Subtract using 2's complement addition.

body.en: To add two 4-bit numbers $A_3A_2A_1A_0$ and $B_3B_2B_1B_0$, four full adders are connected side by side. The carry-out of each stage is the carry-in of the next, so the carry "ripples" from the LSB to the MSB; this is a ripple-carry adder. The final carry $C_4$ is the fifth bit of the sum. IC 7483 is a 4-bit binary *parallel* adder. Its drawback is speed: the last sum is correct only after the carry has passed through every stage.

points.en: n-bit *adder* = n full adders (LSB stage may be a half adder)
Carry ripples from LSB to MSB
Delay grows with the number of bits

narration.en: Four full adders in a row make a 4-bit adder. Each carry-out feeds the next carry-in, so the carry ripples from the least significant bit to the most significant bit.
narration.kn: ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಕಲಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಲಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ 4-ಬಿಟ್ ಸಂಕಲಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದರ ಕ್ಯಾರಿ-ಔಟ್ ಮುಂದಿನದರ ಕ್ಯಾರಿ-ಇನ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಕ್ಯಾರಿ LSB ಯಿಂದ MSB ಕಡೆಗೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Carry ripples from LSB to MSB.
IC 7483: 4-bit parallel adder.
Delay grows with the number of bits.
Four full adders side by side. The A and B bits come in from the top and the sums come out below.
The carry enters at the right, at the least significant bit, and ripples left. C4 is the extra fifth bit.
Now subtraction. A half subtractor: difference is XOR and a borrow is needed only for 0 minus 1.
Nine minus five by two’s complement: invert 0101 to get 1010, add one to get 1011, then add it to 1001.
One XOR gate per B line makes the adder a subtractor. M equal to 0 adds; M equal to 1 inverts B and sets the carry-in to 1.

narration.en: On the board: Ripple-carry adder and 2’s complement subtraction.

say.en: On the board: Ripple-carry adder and 2's complement subtraction.

narration.en: Four full adders are chained: each carry-out (orange) is the next carry-in, so the carry ripples from the LSB to the MSB. With M = 1, XOR gates invert B and Cin = 1, so the circuit adds the 2's complement of B: it subtracts. Then C4 = 1 means the answer is positive.
narration.kn: ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಕಲಕಗಳ ಸರಪಳಿ: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಯಾರಿ ಮುಂದಿನದಕ್ಕೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. M = 1 ಆದಾಗ B ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ Cin = 1, ಅಂದರೆ B ಯ 2 ರ ಪೂರಕ ಸೇರಿಸಿ ವ್ಯವಕಲನ.

say.en: Four full adders are chained: each carry-out orange is the next carry-in, so the carry ripples from the LSB to the MSB. With M equals 1, XOR gates invert B and Cin equals 1, so the circuit adds the 2's complement of B: it subtracts. Then C4 equals 1 means the answer is positive.
say.kn: ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಕಲಕಗಳ ಸರಪಳಿ: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಯಾರಿ ಮುಂದಿನದಕ್ಕೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. M equals 1 ಆದಾಗ B ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ Cin equals 1, ಅಂದರೆ B ಯ 2 ರ ಪೂರಕ ಸೇರಿಸಿ ವ್ಯವಕಲನ.

body.en: A *half subtractor* finds $A - B$ for two bits: difference $D = A\oplus B$ and borrow $B_o = \bar{A}B$ (a borrow is needed only for 0 − 1). A full subtractor also takes a borrow-in: $D = A\oplus B\oplus B_{in}$ and $B_o = \bar{A}B + B_{in}\,\overline{(A\oplus B)}$.

points.en: *Half subtractor*: D = A ⊕ B, Bo = ĀB

narration.en: The difference bit of a subtractor is again an XOR. A borrow is needed only when we take 1 from 0, so the half subtractor borrow is A-bar B.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಕಲಕದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಬಿಟ್ ಕೂಡ XOR. 0 ಯಿಂದ 1 ಕಳೆಯುವಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎರವಲು (ಬಾರೋ) ಬೇಕು; ಅರ್ಧ ವ್ಯವಕಲಕದ ಬಾರೋ = ĀB.

say.en: The difference bit of a subtractor is again an XOR. A borrow is needed only when we take 1 from 0, so the half subtractor borrow is A-bar B. Half subtractor: D equals A ⊕ B, Bo equals ĀB.
say.kn: ವ್ಯವಕಲಕದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಬಿಟ್ ಕೂಡ XOR. 0 ಯಿಂದ 1 ಕಳೆಯುವಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎರವಲು (ಬಾರೋ) ಬೇಕು; ಅರ್ಧ ವ್ಯವಕಲಕದ ಬಾರೋ = ĀB.

say.en: Full subtractor: D equals A ⊕ B ⊕ Bin.
Bo equals ĀB plus Bin (A ⊕ B)′.

body.en: Digital systems subtract by adding: $A - B = A + (\bar{B} + 1)$, where $\bar{B} + 1$ is the 2’*s complement* of B. In a 4-bit adder–subtractor each B bit passes through an XOR gate whose other input is a control line M. When M = 0 the XORs pass B and $C_0 = 0$: the circuit adds. When M = 1 the XORs invert B and $C_0 = 1$: the circuit adds the 2’s complement, i.e. subtracts. If an end carry appears, it is discarded and the result is positive.

points.en: 2’*s complement* = invert all bits, then add 1
M = 0: A + B; M = 1: A − B
End carry 1 → discard it; result is positive

narration.en: To subtract, we add the two’s complement: invert B and add one. An XOR gate on each B line, controlled by M, turns one adder into an adder-subtractor.
narration.kn: ಕಳೆಯಲು 2ರ ಪೂರಕವನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ: B ಯ ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ 1 ಸೇರಿಸಿ. M ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿತ XOR ಗೇಟ್‌ಗಳು ಸಂಕಲಕವನ್ನು ಸಂಕಲಕ-ವ್ಯವಕಲಕವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: To subtract, we add the two's complement: invert B and add one. An XOR gate on each B line, controlled by M, turns one adder into an adder-subtractor. 2's complement equals invert all bits, then add 1.
say.kn: ಕಳೆಯಲು 2ರ ಪೂರಕವನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ: B ಯ ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ 1 ಸೇರಿಸಿ. M ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿತ XOR ಗೇಟ್‌ಗಳು ಸಂಕಲಕವನ್ನು ಸಂಕಲಕ-ವ್ಯವಕಲಕವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Add A equals 1011 and B equals 0110 with a 4-bit parallel adder C0 equals 0. Show the carry at each stage.
Stage 0: 1 plus 0 plus 0 equals 1 gives S0 equals 1, C1 equals 0.
Stage 1: 1 plus 1 plus 0 equals 10 gives S1 equals 0, C2 equals 1.
Stage 2: 0 plus 1 plus 1 equals 10 gives S2 equals 0, C3 equals 1.
Stage 3: 1 plus 0 plus 1 equals 10 gives S3 equals 0, C4 equals 1. Result 10001 equals 17 equals 11 plus 6.
So the answer is C4 S3 S2 S1 S0 equals 1 0001 17.

problem.en: A full subtractor has A = 0, B = 1 and Bin = 1. Find D and Bo.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A full subtractor has A = 0, B = 1 and Bin = 1. Find D and Bo.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A full subtractor has A equals 0, B equals 1 and Bin equals 1. Find D and Bo.
D equals A ⊕ B ⊕ Bin equals 0 ⊕ 1 ⊕ 1 equals 0.
A ⊕ B equals 1, so (A ⊕ B)′ = 0.
Bo equals ĀB plus Bin(A ⊕ B)′ = 1 1 plus 1 0 equals 1.
Check: 0 minus 1 minus 1 equals minus 2: borrow 1 worth 2 and difference 0.
So the answer is D equals 0, Bo equals 1.
